metaTitle: Custom Writing Tools with Carabiner | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom writing tools with carabiner at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for on-the-go branding. Order bulk pens with carabiner clips today.
introHtml: Carabiner clips on pens and markers let your team or customers clip a branded writing tool to a belt loop, backpack, or keychain. Unlike standard pocket pens, these stay accessible during site walks, trade shows, or warehouse shifts. The Push Pop Pen with Carabiner offers a click-to-retract design, while the Eclair 4-in-1 Multi-Function Pen combines pen, stylus, and more in one durable body. Imprint your logo on the barrel for daily visibility.
heroAltText: Custom writing tools with carabiner clip, including a push pop pen and a multi-function pen, displayed on a lanyard.
